reason: I already have a builder in mind, so the job itself is not the problem; I only want the paperwork and payment handled. A platform that wants a fee on top of a price nobody has named is a reason to hold off, not to sign up.
objection: I don't know yet whether the platform's fee is worth it, since the price is not stated. If it takes a cut of a renovation budget, I'd be paying extra for a contract my lawyer or the builder could draw up.
would_change_my_mind: A published, flat fee that is clearly small next to the job, plus proof the payment holds back money until each stage is signed off.
